name: Lumora Press Shortcodes
description: Shows a ready-to-copy [lumora_gallery_album] shortcode on each album/image's admin and public info page, plus a Multi-Album Shortcode tool for combining several albums into one shortcode, for pasting into Lumora Press posts via that project's own companion Lumora Gallery Shortcodes plugin. Static text generation only — no connection to a Lumora Press install.
author: Ariane
